240-647-5470-8250.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scarland Thrinax
Repeat from step 2.

586-864-3125-3899-5477.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
586-864-3125-3899-5477.description:
Activate Spawning Pit twice by sacrificing Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness.
Cast Victimize by paying {2}{B} and sacrificing another creature, returning Eternal Witness and Priest of Gix from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Priest of Gix and Eternal Witness enter, they each trigger as well as Insidious Roots.
Resolve the Priest of Gix trigger, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Insidious Roots trigger, creating a creature token and putting a +1/+1 counter on each Plant you control
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Victimize from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

1115-3132-3259.easyPrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
1115-3132-3259.notablePrerequisites: At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-3132-3259.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Bladewing, triggering Breath of Fury and Bladewing.
Resolve the Bladewing trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

513-3682.notablePrerequisites: You control a legendary creature that has a color that matches the mana symbol in the other permanent's mana cost.
513-3682.description:
Activate Mox Amber by tapping it, adding {1}.
Cast the permanent by paying at most one colored mana.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Sol Ring from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Mox Amber by paying {0}
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning the permanent cast in step 2 from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
513-3682.notes: If the permanent can be cast by paying {0}, this combo nets infinite colored mana. The permanent must be a creature to get infinite ETB and LTB triggers.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

3259-5434-5768.notablePrerequisites:
Origin of the Hidden Ones has exactly two lore counters on it.
You control at least one Assassin that does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5434-5768.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
Origin of the Hidden Ones' third chapter ability triggers, causing you to create an Assassin token whenever an Assassin attacks this turn and sacrifice Origin of the Hidden Ones.
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached, and at least one Assassin if the creature with Breath of Fury attached isn't an Assassin, as attackers.
Origin of the Hidden Ones triggers, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token that's tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

765-1308-1558-2638-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
765-1308-1558-2638-4231.description:
Play Guildless Commons.
When Guildless Commons enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Anointed Procession.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

5256-5571-7310--6.description:
Use Kitsune to give Blightbeetle to an opponent
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the undying creature.
When the undying creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield without a +1/+1 counter on it due to Blightbeetle.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Repeat from step 2.

2034-5687-7084.easyPrerequisites:
You control a land.
You control another nonland creature.
2034-5687-7084.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another nonland creature.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Skittering Precursor and Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger.
Resolve the Beifong's Bounty Hunters trigger, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.
2034-5687-7084.notes: You can instead sacrifice the creature tokens to their own abilities instead of sacrificing them to Ashnod's Altar.

1482-4195-4574-6900.description:
Activate Jeweled Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it.
Ich-Tekik's second ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it and each Golem you control.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Jeweled Lotus from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast Jeweled Lotus from the top of your library by paying 0 life.
Repeat.

1965-5220-6247.description:
Cast Omarthis by paying {0}.
Omarthis enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness, triggering Mortuary and High-Society Hunter.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Omarthis from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the High-Society Hunter trigger, causing you to draw a card, thus drawing Omarthis from your library.
Repeat.

934-1399-1606-2404.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures.
934-1399-1606-2404.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Gaea's Cradle.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

1921-2534-4659.description:
Activate Tawnos's second ability by paying {1}{W}{U}{B}, tapping it and sacrificing two artifact tokens, exiling Coercive Recruiter from your graveyard and creating a token copy of it that is an artifact in addition to its other types.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Tawnos's first ability by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a copy of the Coercive Recruiter token and causing you to mill two cards.
When the Coercive Recruiter token enters, it triggers, untapping Tawnos.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Coercive Recruiter token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat from step 3.

4389-6185-6280.notablePrerequisites: You have at least seven cards in hand.
4389-6185-6280.description:
Activate Grave-Shell Scarab's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it, causing you to mill a number of cards and return Grave-Shell Scarab from your graveyard to your hand due to its dredge ability.
Repeat.

428-2736-5096-5362.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
428-2736-5096-5362.description:
Activate Zedruu the Greathearted by paying {U}{R}{W}, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 6.

2292-4338-4875.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing any other creature.
When the creature dies as a Cleric due to Conspiracy, Rotlung Reanimator triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Repeat.

2034-3490-3798.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
2034-3490-3798.description:
Cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
The creature enters the battlefield, triggering Champion of Lambholt, putting a +1/+1 counter on Champion of Lambholt.
Animation Module triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the token, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Vito, Thorn of the Dusk Rose

314-1496-4658.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is higher than or equal to an opponent's.
314-1496-4658.description:
Cast Soul of Eternity by paying {5}{W}{W}.
Soul of Eternity enters the battlefield, triggering Verdant Sun's Avatar, causing you to gain life equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness.
Vito triggers, causing target opponent whose lifetotal is less than or equal to Soul of Eternity's toughness to lose life equal to the life you gained.
The opponent loses the game due to having zero or less life.

413-893-4853.description:
Activate Myr Turbine by tapping it, creating a 1/1 Myr artifact creature token.
When the Myr enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the Myr.
When the Myr dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Myr Turbine.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability.
Repeat.
